rejected_inferences.reason: MagicMock and AsyncMock ProductionRoutingService fixtures establish route mapping and serialization only; they do not prove durable database reads, worker transitions, or live provider behavior.
The test names a mocked RunPod path but only supplies an AsyncMock service; it is not evidence of QueueClient or RunPod cancellation.
A single terminal-state POST and echoed state do not establish replay idempotency; the same limit applies to the failed and cancelled terminal-state cases.
Seeded Decimal and cost quote values establish the response cost shape only; they are not real billing, an invoice, or provider reconciliation evidence.
